This looks great — you captured all five of the things I was worried about, and reading it back it matches what I pictured.

A couple of small reactions, both fine as-is:

- On saving a link I already have, opening the existing one for editing is exactly what I wanted. And I like that a slightly different page on the same site still counts as its own bookmark.
- The read-later list being separate from favorites, and the two not stepping on each other, is just right.
- The search covers what I asked for. The only thing I'll mention for down the road — not something to change now — is that eventually I might want to group parts of a search together (like "this site, and either of two tags"). I'm happy to leave that out of this first version.

So yes, I approve the specification. Please go ahead and put together the implementation plan for me to look at next.
